name: Studio Name
tagline: Identity, editorial and type design for people who care how it is made.
bio_lead: I design identities, books and typefaces. Twelve years of it, mostly for cultural institutions, independent brands and publishers who want the work to outlast the trend it was made in.
bio_body: The process is unfashionably slow at the start and very fast at the end. I read the brief properly, draw a lot, throw most of it away, and hand over a system you can actually run without me. Available for commissions and collaborations.
seo_title: Studio Name — Graphic Designer | Identity, Editorial & Type
seo_description: Portfolio of Studio Name, a graphic designer working in brand identity, editorial design and typeface design for cultural institutions and independent brands.
